title: Blue Moon
meta_description: Blue Moon is a Gulf-front Panama City Beach townhome with 3 king suites, sunset balcony, and sand just steps from the door. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded:
Tucked onto the quiet west end of Panama City Beach, Blue Moon is a Gulf-front townhome where the sand is just a short walk down a private boardwalk and the horizon stretches wide from nearly every window. Spread across three sunlit levels, this 1,665-square-foot retreat sleeps eight in three king suites --- ideal for a family getaway, a multi-gen trip, or a group of friends who'd rather hear waves than traffic.

The main living level is the heart of the home: an open-concept great room anchored by a Gulf-view living area, a dining table ready for grouper tacos and long conversations, and a bright kitchen with a full-size island, stainless appliances, and enough counter space to cook for the whole crew. Coastal blue accents, white woodwork, and beachy artwork keep the vibe relaxed and unmistakably Florida --- think morning coffee with the sliders open and the sound of surf rolling in.

Each bedroom is a true retreat with its own ensuite bath. The first-floor king is a quiet ground-level escape, while upstairs you'll find a second king suite and a flexible third bedroom with a king plus a built-in twin-over-twin bunk --- perfect for kids, cousins, or anyone who claims the top bunk first. A stacked washer/dryer tucked behind the scenes keeps beach towels in rotation.

Outside is where Blue Moon earns its name. The first-floor lounge is set up for all-day hangs with a dining table, cushioned sofa-style seating, and a clear shot to the Gulf --- umbrellas up, drinks poured, toes in the sand within seconds. Upstairs, a second-level balcony catches the breeze and frames those legendary Emerald Coast sunsets. Grab the kayak and beach gear from the garage, and you're set for the day.

When the day winds down, Blue Moon rewards you with quiet --- no high-rise shadows, no crowded elevators, just a soft Gulf breeze and a sky full of stars. Whether you're here to unplug, celebrate, or simply let the kids run straight from bed to beach, this is the kind of place that makes a week feel like a month in the best possible way.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Beach chair service is not provided. Guests may contact "Chairs for You" if this service is needed.
- There is a kayak and beach chairs for guest use in the garage

Parking Details:
- On-site parking for 2 cars max (1 in the garage and 1 directly outside of the garage).
- Only 2 vehicles per unit may be parked on the property.
- No vehicles may park outside the designated parking spaces (vehicles must be parked inside the yellow line in front of the townhome or in the garage).
- All vehicles must display a valid parking pass at all times.
- Oversized vehicles may be parked between building or in front of the office IF there is space available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
